lines.text: For sinning unintentionally against the LORD's holy things, a man brings an unblemished ram as his guilt offering.
For the holy thing he harmed, he repays its value plus a fifth and gives it to the elders.
A man who broke a commandment without knowing it is guilty, and the priest makes atonement with a ram.
A man who deceives his neighbor acts unfaithfully against Aaron, and he must return what he took.
He brings the priest an unblemished ram from the flock, and the priest makes atonement so he is forgiven.
